background.turn12_escape_history: DevilMedlar told Nyxara that he was born inside the Velvet Coil and escaped at age 7. As a child he was kept outside the cult's adult sexual rites but raised under its secrecy, isolation, loyalty conditioning, and coercive control. He learned that leaving was treated as betrayal and outsiders were described as dangerous. During a violent storm, floodwater jammed a maintenance sluice partly open; he crawled through the service channel and ran until the compound was out of sight. He deliberately stopped the story at the escape and revealed nothing to Nyxara about what happened afterward.

scene.location: Culvert maintenance chamber beyond the first bend, north drainage gully outside Vespergate
scene.time: Night, roughly three hours after dusk
scene.situation: Session 1 Turn 12. DevilMedlar waited for the bound captive to wake naturally. Natural recovery 1d4 = 3 hours. During the wait, Ledger Investigation 4 - 1 = 3 vs DC 14 failed to decode additional Velvet Coil shorthand beyond the confirmed names, payments, routes, coded marks, and Silken Cup cellar-delivery lead. Key/chamber Investigation 5 - 1 = 4 vs DC 13 failed to find a matching lock; the three-coil key fits none of the obvious chamber hardware, lantern fittings, shaft grate, or visible mechanisms. Nyxara explained that the Silken Cup is an upscale winehouse and performance salon in Vespergate's Lantern Quarter with private rooms and a rear cellar-delivery entrance. She has watched discreet late-night couriers use that entrance and suspects the ledger notation marks covert movement, though that remains an inference. During natural conversation, Nyxara asked what DevilMedlar meant by surviving the Velvet Coil. He disclosed that he was born inside the cult and escaped at age 7, describing childhood indoctrination, secrecy, isolation, and coercive control without describing sexual acts involving a child. He told her that a storm jammed a maintenance sluice open and he escaped through the service channel, then deliberately ended the story at the escape. Persuasion 17 + 2 = 19 vs DC 14 succeeded on the info-for-info exchange. Nyxara reciprocated: the woman in the ledger is Mara Veyl, age 21, Nyxara's adult younger sister. Mara is not known to be a Velvet Coil member; Nyxara believes she is a target. Nyxara grew up in Vespergate, worked first as a courier, then became a tracker and Veilblade, and began hunting the Coil after noticing a watcher following Mara and tracing one watcher toward the Silken Cup. Personal trust increased substantially while romance and party membership remain unconfirmed. At the end of the three-hour wait, the captive naturally regained consciousness at 1 HP. He is awake, groggy, bound, fully disarmed, and sees DevilMedlar and Nyxara with the ledger.

clues.ledger_confirmed: Confirmed Velvet Coil ledger remains secured. Turn 12 deeper study failed to decode additional shorthand.
clues.silken_cup_lead: Nyxara identifies the Silken Cup as an upscale Vespergate Lantern Quarter winehouse/performance salon with private rooms and a rear cellar-delivery entrance. She has observed discreet late-night couriers using that route and suspects covert Velvet Coil movement, but that suspicion is not yet proven.
clues.three_coil_key: Matching lock remains unknown after failed Turn 12 search.
clues.nyxara_family_reveal: The woman in the ledger is Mara Veyl, Nyxara's younger sister, age 21 and explicitly adult. Mara is not known to be a Velvet Coil member; Nyxara believes she is being watched/selected as a target.
clues.devilmedlar_escape_reveal: DevilMedlar was born inside the Velvet Coil and escaped at age 7 through a storm-opened maintenance sluice. His childhood disclosure focused on indoctrination, secrecy, isolation, and coercive control; he revealed nothing about events after the escape.
clues.captive_awake: Captured shrine carver naturally regained consciousness after three hours and is awake at 1 HP, bound and disarmed.
